pages.title: Catch'n'Merge
pages.creator: Pro Mobile
pages.description:
Catch'n'Merge alternates between catching creatures and combining them. During the day, move a flask beneath falling creatures and gems while keeping it away from boulders. The collection you build in this arcade phase supplies the pieces for the next part of the game.

At night, drop the creatures into a jar, where matching ones combine into larger forms. A good daytime catch gives you more opportunities to trigger successive merges. Work through the alternating phases to discover how far you can advance along the creature evolution chain.
